name: quarkus
description: Quarkus 3 guidance: configuration, REST resources, validation, security, testing, native images, container specifics, and CDI bean rules; includes a native-image test script.
decides: The stack ADR chooses Quarkus as the application framework.

options.description: No Spring APIs, not even through Quarkus's Spring compatibility extensions; Spring annotations and imports are blocked.
Hexagonal layering with domain/, app|application|usecase/ and infra|infrastructure/ packages: the domain is framework-free, the domain imports neither app nor infra, and app does not import infra.
Application-layer use cases are JSR-330 @Named beans with constructor injection; CDI scope annotations there are flagged.
